data.revised_prompt:
Create a single 1536x1152 PNG sprite sheet for a compact 2D game damage attack FX animation. Use the provided dragon reference only for palette/style: royal blue dragon energy, cyan horn-crown glow, sharp white highlights, gold-and-white elite accents, jewel-like sparks, polished aquatic fantasy sprite style. Use the provided layout guide only for invisible layout: 3 rows x 4 columns, equal frame slots, centered spacing and safe padding. Do NOT reproduce guide elements.

Canvas: exactly 1536x1152. Arrange exactly 12 frames in a 3 rows x 4 columns grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each invisible cell is 384x384. Background must be 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta everywhere, including between frames and margins. No transparency needed; solid magenta background. No text, labels, UI, numbers, letters, watermarks, visible grid lines, frame borders, boxes, guide marks, safe-area rectangles, or center marks.

Critical containment: every FX element in each frame must stay inside the central 60% to 68% of its invisible 384x384 cell, with a very large empty magenta safety margin on all four sides. No tip, spark, shard, smoke, ring, glow, or particle may touch or approach a cell edge. Keep same bounding box, pixel scale, and visual center across all 12 frames. Peak impact must remain compact, not filling the cell.

Style: clean HD pixel-inspired game sprite FX, crisp readable silhouettes, saturated blue/cyan/white/gold palette, polished RPG battle damage effect. FX-only, no full character body, no cards, no card vortex, no card collection, no poker card faces, no J letters, no ranks, no suit icons, no black background, no wide fullscreen blast. Detached sparks allowed only tightly grouped near damage impact and fully inside central safe area.

Animation concept: “Dragon Prince Damage Verdict” — hostile royal dragonfire damage projectile and hit impact against player, after cards are already collected. It should read as damage, impact, score loss. Compact centered avatar damage effect.

Frame contents:
1. Tiny cyan crown-horn spark, hostile and sharp, no cards.
2. Spark stretches into a small blue-white fang of energy with two tiny gold accents.
3. Compact dragonfire bolt, angled forward, white-hot core, short tail.
4. Sharper bolt, still small and centered, no wide trail.
5. First contact slash: short diagonal blue-white cut mark with gold rim, contained.
6. Impact build: compact star at center, cyan flame petals, small gold shards.
7. Peak damage impact: bright but compact white core, jagged blue dragonfire burst and gold shock spikes, all within central safe area.
8. Small damage shock ring with cyan edge and gold cracks, ring does not exceed central safe area.
9. Recoil flame curls backward like a dragon tail, smaller than impact.
10. Fragment fade: cyan embers, gold splinters, thin white hit scars.
11. Residual damage mark: faint blue burn slash and tiny jewel sparks.
12. Loop-ready settle: almost empty, one small cyan spark and a fading gold glint.

Make silhouettes crisp, pixel-art inspired with anti-aliased HD polish, transparent-ready edges against magenta. Maintain compact centered effects in every frame.
